sections.label: Face
sections.text:
Wh'inkled, cold, dry, pale, lilue rin{,»s around
dull-looking eyes. Comeciones, with emaciation. Nose-
bleed. Auiiiuma of the face.

sections.label: Stomach
sections.text:
Slimy taste. Appetite good, but emac'a-
tion progresses. Food passes undigested. Pain in
stomach; worse at night; cutting, gnawing pain. Stom-
ach feels as if szunmming in zuater; feels cold. Gnawing
hunger and whining. Indigestion, with vomiting of
large quantities of offensive fluid.

sections.label: Abdomen
sections.text:
Hard, lumps in abdomen. Distended.
Alternate diarrhoea and constijiation. Ha.‘morrhoids ;
frequent urging; bloody stools; worse as rheumatic
pains abate. Ascarides. Oozing from umbilicus. Seri-
sation as if bowels were .sinking down. '

sections.label: Respiratory
sections.text:
Raw feeling. Impeded respiration.
Dry cough following diarrhoea. Pain across chest; se*-
vere in region of heart.

sections.label: Back
sections.text:
Neck so weak cannot hold head up. Back
lame, weak, and painful. Pain in lumbar region ex-

4


tending along spermatic cord. Pain in sacrum, with
haemorrhoids.

sections.label: Extremities
sections.text:
Pain in shoulders, arms, wrists, and
ankles. Pricking and coldness in fingers and feet. Legs
greatly emaciated. Joints stiff and lame. Painful con-
traction of limbs. [Amin, mur.]

sections.label: Skin
sections.text:
Eruptions come out on face ; are suppressed,
and the skin becomes purplish. Skin fiabby and loose.
Furuncles. Falling out of hair. Itching chilblains.

sections.label: Modalities
sections.text:
Worse, cold air, checked secretions.
Better, motion.

sections.label: Relationship
sections.text:
Compare : Scrophukiria; Bryonia;
Bencoic acid, in gout. Iodine, Natr. mur. in marasmus.
